description: Compare AI visibility across multiple entities side-by-side. Probes each entity (your brand + N competitors) with ai_visibility_check, ranks by score, surfaces which is most/least recognized. Useful for competitive AI-marketing audits: "does Claude know about us as well as our competitors?". Returns ranked list with score, confidence, signal density per entity.

_apiKey.description: Optional Anthropic API key — only if "anthropic" is in models. Passed to api.anthropic.com per probe.

context.description: Optional shared context applied to every probe (e.g. "B2B SaaS", "Boston restaurant"). Disambiguates common names.

entities.description: Array of 2-8 entities to compare (brand/business/product names). First entry treated as the "subject" for narrative; rest are competitors.

models.description: Which models to probe. Supported: "workers-ai" (free default), "anthropic" (requires _apiKey). Omit for just workers-ai.

name: scan_competitor_ai_presence
title: Scan Competitor AI Presence
